Update README.md so that every documented default, in the table and in the prose, matches DEFAULTS in repo/config.mjs. Keep the table's format. Do not change repo/config.mjs or any other file.

files.repo/README.md:
# pilot-client

Settings and their defaults:

| Setting | Default |
|---|---|
| `port` | `3000` |
| `retries` | `5` |
| `timeoutMs` | `15000` |
| `logLevel` | `debug` |

By default the client retries 5 times before giving up and waits 15000 ms for each attempt.
